Careers

Build what comes next.

We're a small studio, and we hire rarely and deliberately. Here's what it's like to build with us.

Small by design

We stay small enough that everyone touches real product, not just their one slice of it.

Build to learn

Every project is a chance to get better at something specific — a technique, a tool, a way of thinking.

Ship, then improve

We favor working software over polished plans. The feedback from something real is worth more than speculation.

Open positions

We don’t have any open roles right now.

We hire rarely, and only when there’s real work that needs another builder. If that changes, it’ll show up here first — no need to check anywhere else.
